cases.question: What about 50% less sunshine?
cases.message: With 50% lower forecast sunshine: The model cannot supply all essential equipment: 1.200 kWh is unserved. Scheduling alone cannot resolve this modeled shortage. Solar generation is 4.071 kWh versus 8.142 kWh for the forecast. Each case has its own computed schedule. Compared with the existing schedule, the recommended schedule ends the day with 0.306 kWh more stored in the battery and 0.016 kWh less lost in battery conversion. These are separate figures, not a total energy saving. The two schedules complete different amounts of flexible work, so this is not a like-for-like comparison.
